# Blue Prince Randomizer Setup Guide

## Required Software

- [Archipelago](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases/latest)
- [The Blue Prince apworld](https://github.com/NewSoupVi/Archipelago/releases),
  if not bundled with your version of Archipelago

## How to play

carefully
